snippet.title: Nomad gameplay (PC Game, 1993)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Nomad (aka project nomad), Dos PC game produced by GameTek in 1993 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/nomad/540/
Watching the intro and exploring the universe in this sci-fi adventure.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
